controls: DVD Player ############################################ Comment I use this remote as controller for mythtv because of this I renamed some of the buttons The key 'C' of the number pad is remapped to ESC because this remote has no 'Exit / Back' Button There are also no keys for Volume UP /DOWN on this remote I mapped Volume UP/DOWN on the effect and Return keys The config file was created with a serial receiver ( selfmade ) ############################################
